Defendant Quenneville Alloys Inc. is incorporated in Delaware with its principal place of business in Louisville, Kentucky — citizen of Delaware and Kentucky. Both the complete diversity and amount-in-controversy requirements are satisfied independently. Diversity jurisdiction therefore exists for Scenario 3. Determination: approved.
